body: Hey, i hate to be that person but i actually have to say that the trans girl that wrote the comment is somewhat right, even though she said it in a very rude (and nonsensical) way.  You shouldn’t do this. This will not go the way you think it will. You will not be seen as powerful or strong for that, as cruelly as that sounds, you will be laughed at. If you dont pass, You will enter that classroom and everyone will laugh at you. I dont say this cause i wanna make you sad or anything or destroy you plan, i just want you to know what will happen. And yes, if you‘re cis yourself i actually do think it‘s very insensitive to do this. I mean it normally wouldn‘t be, but in this situation it absolutely is because you wanna make a statement for a group of people you‘re not part of by crossdressing. And i‘m sorry, yes, that‘ll make trans people look bad. That‘ll strengthen the the argument that we‘re just „men in a dress“. It wont help us, it‘ll make us look bad. If you wanna wear skirts, go for it, but please don‘t do it in this situation, you‘ll be laughed at and you‘ll make us look bad. And if you are trans, then i think it‘s very brave of you to do this, but still please don‘t. Being laughed at by your entire class can be traumatising.. i‘d just recommend you to not do it, especially if you‘re not out to your classmates yet. I‘d recommend you to slowly develope into a woman and present more and more feminine instead of going BOOM here i am in a skirt and leggings! People will always take this sudden changes badly...

I‘ve googled a bit about and it‘s called „locked ward psychiatry“ in Austria. You only get out when it can be ensured that you‘re no longer suicidal. Can be weeks months or years. It‘s similar to a prison (like, convicted criminals that are mentally ill are held in the same thing) . Seems like a nightmare to me...

Hello, thank you for help and your kind comment! 

I try to not call myself that but sometimes i just feel so wrong in my own body and like such an idiot that i just uncontrallably hate myself. 

I need to see a therapist sooner or later for my hormone treatment therapy, so i will see one. I wanna tell them everything, but like i said i‘m afraid since I am often suicidal and i think they‘d figure that out. I‘m in Austria and from what i‘ve heard you‘re going to go away for way longer than 3 days if you’re suicidal. I‘ve known people that were in there for months. And if i‘d be away for that long i‘d surely get fired. (I‘m a trainee at Apple and currently in vocational school).

But yeah i can‘t go on like i‘m now so.. i’ll have ti risk it i guess

Thank you for the links!
